title: Structure and Dual Emission of a Heteropentanuclear Er4Yb Complex

material_class.structural_family: heteropentanuclear Er4Yb cluster with bridging acetate, hydroxide, and 2-methyl-8-hydroxyquinoline

synthesis.procedure: Complex Er4Yb was obtained by reaction of Yb(Mq)3·H2O with four equivalents of Er(hfac)2(CH3COO)(H2O)2 in dichloromethane. The two precursors are almost insoluble in dichloromethane, but the solution became clear as the reaction proceeded. After filtration, crystallization by layering n-hexane onto the concentrated dichloromethane solution afforded the heteropentanuclear complex as pale yellow crystals. ICP indicated an Er(III):Yb(III) molar ratio of 4.28:1.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by filtration and layered crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration; crystallization by layering n-hexane onto concentrated dichloromethane solutions afforded pale yellow crystals

properties.summary: Upon excitation into the n→π* absorption of HMq at 400 nm, the heteropentanuclear complex shows dual NIR emission from Yb(III) (~1015 nm, 2F5/2→2F7/2) and Er(III) (~1535 nm, 4I13/2→4I15/2) in the solid state at 298 K. UV–vis absorption of Er4Yb in dichloromethane is ligand-centered. No up-conversion was observed in the solid state at room temperature upon 980 nm laser irradiation (460 mW), attributed to quenching by coordinated μ3-OH and organic ligands.

measurements.name: excitation wavelength
measurements.conditions: solid state, 298 K; n→π* absorption of HMq

measurements.name: up-conversion emission
measurements.conditions: solid state, room temperature; 980 nm laser irradiation at 460 mW
